title: A Interior for the Silence
author: Lena Pemberton
blurb: Dominic Quintana, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the demolition date arrives.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
